description.zh:
查询对应语言的诊断方案，支持中文（zh-CN）与英文（en-US）。需要注意的是并非所有诊断方案具备英文内容，如诊断方案无英文内容，则返回为空。
<props="china">zh-CN</props>

<props="intl">en-US</props>
description.en:
The language of the diagnostic solution to query. Chinese (zh-CN) and English (en-US) are supported. Not all diagnostic solutions have English content. If a diagnostic solution does not have English content, an empty result is returned.
<props="china">zh-CN</props>

<props="intl">en-US</props>

description.zh: 需要查询诊断方案的错误码。
description.en: The error code for which you want to query the diagnostic solution.

description.zh: 需查询诊断方案的错误消息，必须搭配错误码（errorCode）参数共同使用。
description.en: The error message for which you want to query the diagnostic solution. This parameter must be used together with the errorCode parameter.

description.zh:
产品CODE。

- 调用GetRequestLog接口，从返回结果中获取产品CODE。

- 通过OpenAPI门户的URL，找到对应的产品CODE。例如，<props="china">短信服务的OpenAPI门户URL为https://api.aliyun.com/product/Dysmsapi，根据该URL获取短信服务的产品CODE为Dysmsapi。</props>
<props="intl">短信服务的OpenAPI门户URL为https://api.alibabacloud.com/product/Dysmsapi，根据该URL获取短信服务的产品CODE为Dysmsapi。</props>
description.en:
The product CODE.

- Call the GetRequestLog operation to obtain the product CODE from the response.

- Find the product CODE from the OpenAPI portal URL. For example, <props="china">the OpenAPI portal URL for Short Message Service is https://api.aliyun.com/product/Dysmsapi. Based on this URL, the product CODE for Short Message Service is Dysmsapi.</props>
<props="intl">the OpenAPI portal URL for Short Message Service is https://api.alibabacloud.com/product/Dysmsapi. Based on this URL, the product CODE for Short Message Service is Dysmsapi.</props>

descriptions.zh: 该接口查询的是公开信息，不涉及账号特殊归属等信息，故不支持授权。
descriptions.en: This operation queries publicly available information and does not involve account-specific data. Therefore, authorization is not supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun openapiexplorer get-error-code-solutions --error-code IncorrectStatus.TransitRouter --error-message The_resource_is_not_in_a_valid_state_for_the_operation. --product Ecs --accept-language zh-CN --region cn-hangzhou
